ShortDescription.Value: Press Tab, type, place. Instantly search every building, road and prop in the game, with smart filters, per-city favorites and Find It support.

Publish.LongDescription:
**Stop hunting through tabs. Start building.**
Hundreds of buildings, roads, services and props are buried in menus inside menus. Better Asset Menu puts all of them one keypress away. Press **Tab**, type a few letters, pick your match, and you're placing it. No clicking through categories, no remembering which tab the water tower lives in.
It's the asset menu Cities: Skylines II deserved: fast enough for veterans who know exactly what they want, and friendly enough for new mayors who don't know what anything is called yet.
## Just start typing
Open the menu and type. There's no search box to click. Results narrow with every keystroke. Click what you want, or press Enter once you've narrowed it down, and it's ready to place.
- Type **fire station** and every fire station appears. - Type **road -highway** for every road except highways. - Type **"bus stop"** for that exact phrase.
Not searching? Browse the same tabs and categories as the vanilla toolbar, in a layout that's faster to scan.
## Search like a pro
Filters find things by what they are, not just what they're called. You don't need to memorise anything: suggestions pop up as you type, and Enter accepts them.
- **is: ok** - only what you can place right now - **is: new** - everything you just unlocked - **is: unique -is: placed** - the landmarks still waiting for a spot in your city - **fx: crime** - anything that affects crime; also try **fx: health**, **fx: wellbeing** and **fx: entertainment** - **s: 2x3** - buildings on a lot exactly 2 cells wide and 3 deep - **w: 2u road** - every road 2 cells wide, the "2u road" builders talk about - **zone: residential zone: high** - high-density housing - **theme: european** or **pack:** - a regional style or a content pack - **dlc: none** - base game only; **is: mod** - only mod content - **in: parks bench** - search inside a single tab
Mix and match freely: **school is: ok** shows the schools you can build right now. Made a typo in a filter? It's shown crossed out and ignored, so you never end up staring at an empty list wondering why.
## Every theme, every pack, at your fingertips
Want a North American building in your European city? Search finds assets from every theme and asset pack, without touching the vanilla theme filter. Prefer to see only your city's style? That's one setting away.
## Supercharged with Find It
Already using **Find It**? Better Asset Menu plugs straight into its catalogue. Props, decals, trees, fences, vehicles and everything else Find It knows about become searchable from the same menu, right next to your roads and services.
- A Find It entry at the top of the menu browses all of Find It's categories. - One search covers both the toolbar and Find It's whole catalogue. - The **cat:** filter narrows by Find It category: **cat: decals**, **cat: trees**, **cat: props cat: residential**. - Anything from Find It can go in your favorites too.
Find It isn't required. Without it, Better Asset Menu works with everything in the vanilla toolbar.
## Two ways to play
Pick the menu that fits how you build:
- **Radial:** a wheel of buttons that opens around your cursor or the center of the screen. Point at anything to see its picture, name and details in the middle. Quick, visual and very satisfying. - **Pane:** a keyboard-first list with a big preview beside it. Arrow keys to move, Enter to place, and click any detail (like **theme: European**) to add it to your search, or right-click it to exclude it.
Both search, browse and place exactly the same things. Switch whenever you like.
## Favorites for every city
Right-click anything and add it to your favorites. Each city keeps its own list, saved with the save file, so your downtown build and your farm town each get the tools they need. Typing while in Favorites searches only your favorites.
## Make it yours
- Rebind the open key, or open the menu with a mouse button (the forward button by default) - Scale the wheel or the pane, and tune the wheel's spacing - Open at the mouse cursor or the center of the screen - Hide the vanilla toolbar entirely, or keep the bulldozer where it's always been - Stop menu picks from switching on info views, if you'd rather keep your view - Right-click an item to copy its DLC or mod link
## Learn it in a minute
A full **Usage Guide** tab in the mod's settings walks through every filter and key with examples to try. Every time you open the menu, it suggests a different search to try.
## Bugs, ideas and feedback
Found a bug, or have an idea for a new filter or feature? Tell us on GitHub - there's a short form for each: https://github.com/bengreenier/csii-mods/issues/new/choose
Press Tab and see how fast building can be.
Publish.ChangeLog: First release: radial and pane menus, type-to-search with filters, per-city favorites and Find It support.
